purpose: Bounded verification of the candidate Verlune Premium access product before Human Review H1-H11 and commerce E2E.

provider_identity.historical_identity_is_not_reused: Historical Verlune Code Review / test-provider IDs are not evidence of the new Premium SKU identity.

session_policy.device_reference: Signed non-authorizing browser reference may persist so the same browser can reuse an existing Lemon instance after session expiry.
session_policy.deactivate: Calls provider deactivation, then clears authorization session and device reference.
session_policy.provider_outage: Fail closed for Premium content; preserve valid local references for retry rather than silently granting access.

cases.name: Unauthenticated library is locked
cases.expected: GET /app does not render Premium content and redirects to /unlock.

cases.name: Missing provider configuration fails closed
cases.expected: Unlock cannot authorize Premium when required server configuration or secrets are absent/invalid.

cases.name: Invalid license denied
cases.expected: Invalid license key returns denial and creates no authorization session.

cases.name: Wrong checkout email denied
cases.expected: Valid license with mismatched checkout email is denied before a new provider activation is created.

cases.name: Wrong entitlement identity denied
cases.expected: Store/product/variant mismatch is denied before Premium authorization.

cases.name: Activation-limit policy enforced
cases.expected: License metadata must match the frozen 3-activation Premium policy; provider also denies a fourth active instance.

cases.name: Valid unlock creates secure session
cases.expected: Valid entitlement creates signed HttpOnly SameSite=Lax authorization cookie; Secure in production; raw license key absent from browser cookies.

cases.name: Premium library inventory
cases.expected: Authorized /app exposes exactly the 17 launch-core Premium customer surfaces, including both Builders and both toolkit items.

cases.name: Exact asset identity
cases.expected: Authorized asset body is server-loaded and Git-blob identity matches the frozen catalog metadata before delivery.

cases.name: Premium bytes absent from public bundle
cases.expected: Build audit finds no protected asset markers in public/ or .next/static client artifacts.

cases.name: Session tamper fails closed
cases.expected: Modified or invalid signed session cannot authorize /app.

cases.name: 24-hour entitlement revalidation
cases.expected: A stale authorization session cannot serve Premium until the exact provider instance revalidates.

cases.name: Disabled expired revoked entitlement fails closed
cases.expected: Disabled/expired/invalid provider status or missing instance clears authorization and blocks Premium on revalidation.

cases.name: Provider outage fail-closed retry
cases.expected: Provider/network outage during required revalidation locks Premium, preserves retryable local state, and does not create a redirect loop.

cases.name: Logout semantics
cases.expected: Logout removes authorization but keeps the signed non-authorizing device reference; /app becomes locked immediately.

cases.name: Same-browser re-unlock reuses activation
cases.expected: After logout/session expiry, same browser + same license can reuse its existing valid provider instance without incrementing activation usage.

cases.name: Deactivate semantics
cases.expected: Deactivation removes the provider instance and both local cookies, releasing an activation slot.

cases.name: Deactivation outage is recoverable
cases.expected: If provider deactivation is unavailable, session remains authorized so the user can retry; no false success is shown.

cases.name: Seven-day authorization maximum
cases.expected: Authorization session cannot exceed the frozen seven-day max-age policy.

cases.name: Three-browser policy
cases.expected: Three distinct browser instances can activate; a fourth is denied while all three remain active.

closure_rule.static_build: Typecheck + production build + Premium build leakage audit PASS.
closure_rule.provider_integration: All applicable provider-backed cases PASS against the exact frozen Premium store/product/variant in Lemon Squeezy test mode.
closure_rule.blockers: Any unauthorized Premium delivery, raw-key client exposure, identity mismatch acceptance, session-tamper acceptance, or revoked-entitlement access is blocking.
closure_rule.gate_result: ACCESS_PRODUCT_E2E_PASS only after all 20 cases are PASS or a case is explicitly proven not applicable before execution.

evidence_boundary: Implementation in repository is not deployment evidence.
Build PASS is not provider E2E PASS.
Provider test mode is not live purchase evidence.
Human Review H1-H11 still requires a real reviewer using the candidate customer surface.
Public landing and live sale remain frozen.
